summary: Rafi tries to bargain for hilsa at the bazaar.

lines.en: Today Rafi is at the market.

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.en: Brother, how much is the hilsa?

lines.speaker: Shopkeeper
lines.en: This fish is one thousand taka.

lines.speaker: Shopkeeper
lines.bn: ভাই, এটা ইলিশ! সবচেয়ে ভালো মাছ।
lines.tr: bhai, eta ilish! shobcheye bhalo machh.
lines.en: Brother, this is hilsa! The best fish there is.

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.en: Make it a little cheaper, please.

lines.speaker: Shopkeeper
lines.en: No, brother. That's my final price.

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.en: OK. Give me half a kilo.

lines.speaker: Shopkeeper
lines.bn: আধা কেজি পাঁচশ টাকা। আর কিছু লাগবে?
lines.tr: adha keji pa~chsho taka. ar kichhu lagbe?
lines.en: Half a kilo is five hundred taka. Anything else?

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.bn: এক হালি ডিম আর এক কেজি আলু।
lines.tr: ek hali dim ar ek keji alu.
lines.en: Four eggs and a kilo of potatoes.

questions.question: How much is the whole fish?
questions.why: এক হাজার টাকা = one thousand taka.

questions.question: Which sentence means 'Make it a little cheaper, please'?

options.en: Make it a little cheaper, please.

questions.why: কম রাখেন = 'keep it lower': the classic way to bargain in a Bangladeshi bazaar.

questions.question: How much hilsa does Rafi buy?
What else does Rafi buy?
questions.why: এক হালি ডিম = four eggs (a হালি is a set of four); এক কেজি আলু = a kilo of potatoes.
